summary: Custom auth adapters that extend the AuthAdapter class accept any authData
description:
### Impact

A custom authentication adapter that extends Parse Server's exported `AuthAdapter` class and implements the `validateSetUp`, `validateLogin` and `validateUpdate` methods, as the class documentation describes, never had those methods called. Parse Server instead used a default inherited from the base class, which accepts any authentication data. For a provider served by such an adapter, an attacker can sign up, link an identity, or log in as an existing user without valid credentials for that provider, and can skip a custom adapter that implements an additional authentication factor. Only apps that configure a custom authentication adapter built as a subclass of `AuthAdapter` are affected; built-in adapters and custom adapters defined as plain objects are not affected.

### Patches

Methods that an adapter inherits unchanged from the `AuthAdapter` base class are no longer treated as implemented, so a subclass's own validation methods run, and the adapter's own `beforeFind` method is now also called. The methods of a custom adapter that is a class instance now run on a per-request copy of the configured instance, so they can use its state and helper methods. A subclass that implements only some of `validateSetUp`, `validateLogin` and `validateUpdate` is now rejected as not configured instead of accepting any authentication data. In Parse Server 8, unlinking an authentication provider also no longer calls the adapter's `beforeFind` method, as in Parse Server 9.

### Workarounds

Implement all validation in an overridden `validateAuthData` method of the subclass that does not rely on the adapter instance's own state, or define the custom adapter as a plain object with the validation methods instead of a subclass of `AuthAdapter`.

### References

- GitHub security advisory: https://github.com/parse-community/parse-server/security/advisories/GHSA-rq3w-5c6f-p7wr
- Fix Parse Server 9: https://github.com/parse-community/parse-server/pull/10773
- Fix Parse Server 8: https://github.com/parse-community/parse-server/pull/10774
